Bubble Beam Berry Blast (Japanese: ) is a 1-minute short to celebrate Pokémon throughout the month of June 2024. It was uploaded to the official American and European YouTube channels on June 4, 2024, on the Japanese channel on June 6, 2024, on the Asian channels on Jun 7, 2024.

The short was accompanied by an annoucement of mass outbreaks in featuring Water-type Pokémon such as , , and from June 6 to June 9, 2024, in addition to 7-star Tera Raid Battles featuring announced earlier.
plainText:
Bubble Beam Berry Blast (Japanese: ) is a 1-minute short to celebrate Pokémon throughout the month of June 2024. It was uploaded to the official American and European YouTube channels on June 4, 2024, on the Japanese channel on June 6, 2024, on the Asian channels on Jun 7, 2024.

The short was accompanied by an annoucement of mass outbreaks in featuring Water-type Pokémon such as , , and from June 6 to June 9, 2024, in addition to 7-star Tera Raid Battles featuring announced earlier. 

==Blurb==
 Join our aquatic party of Palafin, Greninja, Quaxly, and Piplup as they lend each other a Helping Hand in their pursuit of berries! 

==Plot==
 , , , and are hanging out near a pond. Palafin points to a Sitrus Berry on a nearby tree and to knock the berry off the tree. While Palafin shows off, Greninja uses its to knock off the berries, and moves at a fast speed to catch it, messing up Quaxly's hair in the process. After Quaxly fixes its hair, it uses to knock off a Tamato Berry from a neighbouring tree. Next, Piplup jumps up on a rock for its turn and uses at a Qualot Berry, but the weak attack fails to knock the berry off the tree. Piplup tries and fails again and falls off the rock. Dejected, it starts walking away. The other Pokémon cheer it using and Piplup aims a powerful Bubble Beam at the berry. However the attack is so powerful that it blows away all the tree leaves, leaving only the trunk behind. As berries start raining down around them, Greninja, Quaxly and Pipulp run away, while a Sitrus Berry falls on Palafin's head.
